title: Volta Grande do Xingu water-flow protest and BR-230 occupation
location: BR-230 km 27 near Altamira, Pará; communities from five municipalities
participants_original: About 150 on opening-day protest, per CPT/ISA-attributed account.
threshold_50_evidence: Contemporary CPT and movement accounts estimate about 150 at the Nov9 occupation; ISA-origin report dates five-day protest to Nov13.
notes: Demands addressed both IBAMA operating-license policy and Norte Energia. IHU explicitly republishes an ISA-written article, not independent of ISA; CPT and Xingu Vivo sources are organizer/community-origin. Overnight road-traffic release is not final protest end; ISA-origin report says ended Nov13 after MPF meeting.

end_date.value: ISA-origin story republished by IHU reports end Nov13 after five days.

location.value: BR-230 km27 near Altamira; five Pará municipalities represented.

participants.value: About 150 at opening-day occupation; multi-day attendance trajectory unknown.

demands.value: Sufficient Xingu water flow, IBAMA suspension of Belo Monte operating license; Norte Energia target.

state_response.value: MPF meeting and commitment to forward demands reported; no final policy concession established.

open_questions: Does evidence establish the manual’s simultaneous ≥50-person public gathering and domestic state/policy demand?
Are episode boundaries, state response and competing source accounts resolved?

title: Paraná educators' Alep occupation, march and hunger-strike encampment
participants_original: About 75 educators marched with another 300 people waiting outside on 19 Nov; ten hunger strikers remained at the reported 26 Nov end.
threshold_50_evidence: CUT reports about 300 people awaiting marchers plus about 75 educators on 19 Nov; clearly above 50. Ten at final hunger-strike stage is not event crowd size.
notes: CUT links the 18 Nov Alep occupation, Nov19 public march and hunger-strike encampment through its reported Nov26 end. Demands were directed to Paraná governor/state education policy. Whether the Nov4/17 marches are part of one broader episode remains for reviewer; no automatic merger.

start_date.value: Alep occupied evening 18 Nov; public departure/march 19 Nov.

end_date.value: APP-Sindicato/CUT says remaining ten strikers ended the eight-day encampment 26 Nov.

participants.value: About 75 education workers and another 300 people accompanied the Nov19 march; ten strikers remained Nov26.

demands.value: Revoke Edital 47, public hiring, career payments, halt school militarization and outsourcing.

state_response.value: CUT reports meeting with legislators/government and APP; no concession established.

open_questions: Does evidence establish the manual’s simultaneous ≥50-person public gathering and domestic state/policy demand?
Are episode boundaries, state response and competing source accounts resolved?
